_description: Held-out set v2, written after the rule-engine and prompt-injection work so it was not seen while building them. Same caveat as v1: small, synthetic, and written by the project author. Includes two adversarial cases (a planted prompt-injection line; unquoted Sysmon paths) and three benign cases.
